name: Auto Responsive Table
author: Dear

sections.description:
PlugIn activation is enough to transform all normal tables into Responsive Tables automatically. Create or edit Tables directly inside Post Editor or Page Editor. But you can edit Settings for more customization.

  • Whether you are on a desktop, laptop, tablet, or smartphone, this PlugIn works smoothly with almost every leading browser, including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, Opera, and Brave
  • Tested to work with commonly used Themes and PlugIns
  • The PlugIn takes very low space in hosting, and optimized to load quickly and use minimal server resources
  • Easy Installation! No Coding Knowledge Required!

Live Preview

Check the Live Preview of Auto Responsive Table for WordPress first, then Install.

Are you happy?

You are requested to provide positive review in WordPress.org with some extra clicks to share this PlugIn in your social network

Looking for something special? Buy Pro

Free version makes all Tables of the entire website responsive. But if you want this option to be page-specific, then you should buy the Paid version : WordPress PlugIn for Responsive Table with Header Sortability. Bonus is, you are getting Header Sortability option too.

  1. Sortable Tables : Paid version offers Header Sorting functionality for Tables. If any Table does not have any header, then the first row will automatically work as header.
  2. Responsiveness Customizable Per Page, Post, Product : Choose whether to apply responsiveness on the tables per-post, or per-page, or per-product basis.
  3. Sortability Customizable Per Page, Post, Product : Choose whether to apply header sorting on the tables per-post, or per-page, or per-product basis.

Enjoy Live Preview of Responsive Table for WordPress with Header Sortability here, and then buy from trusted marketplace Gumroad

Thank you

sections.installation:
Download this free WordPress.org PlugIn, and

Step 1. Open your WordPress Admin Dashboard, click “Add New” in PlugIns section
Step 2. Click on “Upload PlugIn”
Step 3. Select the downloaded package, now click on “Install Now”
Step 4. Click on “Activate PlugIn” to activate the PlugIn

Done! You have successfully installed the WordPress PlugIn. Now see the output in website live in browser.
